_doc: Single definition site for every qualitative disqualifier used by the offer→CV path. morning-briefing (Step 1g scoring) and cv-log-worker (Step A.6 gate) both read THIS file — none of them may restate a disqualifier inline or in prose. Each entry is a content judgment against the JD, not a keyword regex: read `detect` and decide whether the actual JD_TEXT matches it. Compensation figures are a separate concern and stay in comp-thresholds.json — do not add one here.

disqualifiers.label: Hors Paris (strict)
disqualifiers.detect: The role requires on-site presence outside Paris / Île-de-France, with no remote or hybrid option stated anywhere in the JD.

disqualifiers.label: Pas d'IA
disqualifiers.detect: The role has no AI/ML component at all — traditional software engineering, infrastructure, or management with no mention of AI, LLMs, or ML systems in the responsibilities.

disqualifiers.label: PM pur
disqualifiers.detect: The role is pure product management — roadmap and backlog ownership, stakeholder alignment — with no hands-on technical building expected of the person.

disqualifiers.label: Gouvernance sans hands-on
disqualifiers.detect: The role governs or oversees an AI/data practice (framework, compliance, steering committee, COMEX-facing strategy) without any hands-on building, coding, or delivery expected of the person.

disqualifiers.label: FDE / poste à dominante infrastructure
disqualifiers.detect: A Forward Deployed Engineer or similar builder role whose core, required (not 'nice to have') expertise is infrastructure deployment — VPC, on-prem, private cloud, air-gapped or highly restricted environments, SRE, or Kubernetes as a hard requirement — rather than applied-AI/ML delivery.
